target.description: Inflorescence arrangement type (Dirr inflorescences), only on inflorescence crops; an isolated flower does not carry arrangement evidence.

measured_support.source: local app DB, Shenandoah area inst-osm-relation-5548542, species joined to Dirr devo_taxa on binomial (measured 2026-11-12)
measured_support.note: Species/observation support for choosing targets; NOT crop support and NOT a model metric.
measured_support.warning: Support is thin and overlapping (a species may carry more than one inflorescence claim); the join excludes multi-value species. Expect a small, imbalanced dataset.
